newsitem.title: GHANA: SOCCER-GHANA'S HEARTS OF OAK PULL OUT OF AFRICA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GHANA'S HEARTS OF OAK PULL OUT OF AFRICA CUP.

text.p: Ghana's cup holders, Hearts of Oak, pulled out of the African Cup Winners' Cup on Tuesday, saying they could not afford to take part.
A statement signed by board chairman Ato Ahwoi said that the club, which funded a 1995 cup campaign from player transfers, had fialed to find sufficient funds to cover the cost again.
"Unfortunately, the club has not been able to transfer any player this season and therefore cannot use this income source to offset the projected loss," the statement said.
Hearts of Oak were due to launch their campaign in this year's competition this weekend in Conakry away to ASFAG of Guinea.
